title: Execute pruned Gaussian corrections and bound the standalone Newton-W route
body:
The valuation-pruned Gaussian correction in PR5815 now has an executable arbitrary-input implementation: exact Newton coefficients, negative offsets, actual valuations, pruned Walsh gather, full transpose delivery and the true normalization quotient. A different polynomial/tensor oracle agrees on **336 complete parameter cases and98 basis columns**. Source construction credit remains with PR5815.

A shared immutable source bank serves four distinct responses. Gather ADD precision mass falls from84867 to31862. Including all coefficient and synthesis ADDs, the mass falls from169623 to116618: **31.25% less component work**. Source-version reads, initialization, scales, phases, coefficient preparation, output writes, quotient and cleanup remain separately counted. This is not a runtime speedup or a current P104 caller.

The exact all-width degree-zero theorem shows that every proper Walsh prefix still needs full precision. Combined with an explicit **standalone uniform-precision Newton-W bulk graph**, it gives an all-interval lower bound `(n/2)*2^n*p`. At p proportional to n, changing the interval alone cannot give a positive log-exponent saving in that stated precision-work model. Changed bulk graphs, heterogeneous precision and sharing are outside the obstruction; this is not a general Gaussian lower bound.

[Proof and exact hypotheses](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baea91d8c0044a0036006bdd3b4d7bce3d6cf783/research/gaussian-spectral-execution/PROOF.md), [executable compiler](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baea91d8c0044a0036006bdd3b4d7bce3d6cf783/research/gaussian-spectral-execution/compiler.py), [complete invoice and census](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baea91d8c0044a0036006bdd3b4d7bce3d6cf783/research/gaussian-spectral-execution/RESULT.json), [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baea91d8c0044a0036006bdd3b4d7bce3d6cf783/research/gaussian-spectral-execution/VALIDATION.md). Exact valuation pruning saves about1.09% of uniform-mask gather mass across the complete bounded census; the shared fixture supplies a larger positive component result. A shared full transform plus polynomial outputs remains a competing baseline, so no global optimality is claimed.

Python3.12.14 standard-library normal and optimized registered checks pass. The verifier checks all189 complete degree-zero prefix profiles, source/creation-precision/lifetime controls, omitted correction, wrong quotient, wrong coefficient sign and seven actual source corruptions. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and the official19-file export pass. Read-only Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH passed in1.27seconds and preserved all20 files including the manifest.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-spectral-execution
```

Physical routes, native admission, reversible cleanup, complete binary-time tariffs and all five framework assumptions remain open. No new kappa, complete multiplier or selected-frontier change is claimed. Full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; hosted scientific replay and independent human acceptance are pending.

Base canonical main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority8, refreshed before submission. The P104 side-correction card is explicitly changed to this response component and cost audit. Live handoffs/PRs and cached overlap were checked with sparse/unpublished coverage limits. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19209122). Exact publication head `baea91d8c0044a0036006bdd3b4d7bce3d6cf783`.

Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. Credit Dugongue/PR5815, PR5813 and all unchanged source/native/precision/ownership/compiler notices. Only Gaussian integer arithmetic is reused from PR5821. New execution, exact census, source-version controls and scoped cost proof are this contribution. No merge or closure is requested.
